info.title: Keupera Public API
info.description:
Programmatic access to every major Keupera module — Keyword Research, Backlinks, Content, AI Visibility, and Analytics.

All endpoints are served under `https://app.keupera.com/api/v1` and authenticated with a Bearer API key. Responses are JSON and follow a consistent `{ "data": ... }` envelope, with list endpoints adding a `meta` object for pagination.

tags.name: Keywords
tags.description: Research, enrich, and manage keywords and keyword groups. List, add, delete, star, bulk-update status, trigger AI keyword research jobs, and organize keywords into groups.

tags.name: Backlinks
tags.description: Run backlink research campaigns, manage the opportunities discovered for each campaign, and generate or send personalized outreach emails.

tags.name: Content
tags.description: Plan, generate, update, and publish AI-written articles across the full content pipeline, and configure per-website content automation.

tags.name: AI Visibility
tags.description: Track how your brand and competitors appear across LLM answers via Brand Radar campaigns, the Prompt Research Engine, and a consolidated visibility score.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Query website traffic, cached Google Search Console data, and AI bot crawl activity for a website.

tags.name: Account & Utilities
tags.description: Verify credentials, connect CMS integrations, and reference internal endpoints.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of keywords for the authenticated website.

post.description: Adds one or more keywords to a website. Set `enrich: true` to auto-fill volume, difficulty, CPC, and intent via DataForSEO — this consumes keyword research credits.

website_id.description: Target website. Defaults to the API key's website.

enrich.description: Auto-enrich keywords with volume and difficulty data.

delete.description: Deletes one or more keywords by ID.

patch.description: Updates the status of multiple keywords in a single request.

post.description:
Generates keyword ideas using AI plus DataForSEO enrichment.

This is a **long-running job**. By default the endpoint returns a job handle immediately (`202 Accepted`) — poll `GET /keywords/research/{jobId}` with the returned `job_id` until `status` is `completed`. Pass `"sync": true` to wait inline, but this is not recommended as it is subject to gateway timeouts.

Consumes keyword research credits.

sync.description: Set `true` to wait for the inline result (not recommended).

get.description: Returns the current state of a keyword research job. Poll until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.
Returns all keyword groups for a website.

language.description: Language code. Defaults to the website language.

target_domain.description: Domain to research backlinks for. Defaults to the website's own domain. Useful for a subdomain or partner site.

Returns backlink opportunities discovered for a campaign.

Returns a single backlink opportunity, including its parent campaign context.

patch.description: Updates the status, contact details, or notes on an opportunity.

post.description: Generates an AI-written, personalized outreach email for an opportunity. Consumes AI credits.

Sends an outreach email for an opportunity via your organization's configured SMTP. Organization SMTP settings must be configured under **Settings** before sending. Updates the opportunity status to `outreach_sent`.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of articles for a website.

post.description: Plans a new article. Provide either a `title` or a `keyword_id`. Optionally pass an `outline` for AI-assisted drafting and a `date` to schedule publishing.

keyword_id.description: Link to a keyword. Required if no `title`.

get.description: Returns full article details, including linked keyword data.

patch.description: Updates article fields. The `date` field is a shortcut that sets both `published_at` and `scheduled_publish_at`.

delete.description: Deletes an article. If the article is linked to a keyword, the keyword status is reverted to `active`.

post.description: Starts the AI content generation pipeline for a planned article. Consumes AI credits.

get.description: Returns scheduled article events within a date range.
Returns the content automation settings for a website.

patch.description: Updates the content automation settings for a website.

brands.description: Brand objects to track mentions for.

languages.description: Language codes to run the prompt in (max 3).

post.description: Registers a CMS integration against your API key. Used by the Framer plugin and WordPress connector.

site_url.description: WordPress only — your WordPress site URL.

bearerAuth.description: Pass your Keupera API key as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEUPERA_API_KEY`. Generate keys from **Account → API Keys** in your Keupera dashboard.

WebsiteId.name: website_id
WebsiteId.description: Target website. Defaults to the website bound to your API key. Must belong to one of your organizations.

Range.name: range
Range.description: Preset date range. Ignored when both `from` and `to` are provided.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — missing or invalid parameters.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key.

PaymentRequired.description: Usage limit reached — crawl credits, AI credits, or other quota exhausted. Enable metered billing to allow overage.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden — inactive key, no API access on your plan, or the requested website is not yours.

example.error: Your plan does not include Public API access
